title: User login with valid credentials
description: Verify that user can log in successfully with valid username and password, and receives a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input valid username and password
Click the login button
Assert that login is successful and JWT token is received

title: User login fails with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails and proper error message is returned when using invalid username or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input invalid username and/or password
Click the login button
Assert that login is denied with appropriate error message

title: Access protected API without authorization token
description: Verify that accessing APIs that require authentication without a JWT token returns 401 unauthorized error.

steps.description: Send API request to a protected resource without JWT token
Assert that response status code is 401 Unauthorized

title: Access admin-only API with non-admin user
description: Verify that non-admin users cannot access admin-only APIs and receive 403 forbidden or appropriate error.

steps.description: Log in as a staff user
Send API request to an admin-only endpoint
Assert that access is denied with forbidden error

title: Add new member successfully
description: Verify that a new member can be added with valid details and is saved accurately in the database.

steps.description: Log in with appropriate permissions
Navigate to the member management module
Open add new member form and fill valid member details
Submit the form
Assert that the member is added and visible in the member list

title: Edit existing member information
description: Verify that editing an existing member updates member details correctly in the system.

steps.description: Select an existing member from the member list
Open edit member form and update member details
Submit changes
Assert that the updated details are saved and displayed correctly

title: Delete a member and verify removal
description: Verify that a member can be deleted and is removed from the member list and database.

steps.description: Select a member to delete
Confirm deletion
Assert that the member no longer appears in the member list

title: Member renewal with valid card type and date
description: Verify that member card renewal updates the member status, card expiry date, and renewal history correctly.

steps.description: Select a member eligible for renewal
Open renewal dialog, select valid card type and renewal date
Submit renewal
Assert that member status and expiry are updated and renewal history recorded

title: Member check-in deducts times card count correctly
description: Verify that when a member with a times card (次卡) checks in, the remaining times count is decremented by one and check-in record is saved.

steps.description: Select a member holding a valid times card with remaining times
Perform member check-in operation
Assert that remaining times is reduced by one and check-in record saved

title: Check member check-in history query correctness
description: Verify that member's check-in history can be queried accurately showing correct records and timestamps.

steps.description: Select a member with check-in records
Query the check-in history
Assert that all relevant check-in records are displayed with correct data

title: Card type CRUD operations including enable/disable
description: Verify that card types (月卡, 季卡, 年卡, 次卡) can be created, edited, enabled, disabled, and deleted correctly.

steps.description: Create a new card type with all mandatory fields
Assert new card type is added and displayed
Edit an existing card type's details
Assert updates are saved and shown correctly
Disable a card type
Assert card type is marked as disabled and unavailable for selection
Enable the card type
Assert card type is active and selectable
Delete a card type that is not linked to members
Assert card type is removed from the list

title: Employee management CRUD operations with admin role
description: Verify that an admin can add, edit, delete employee accounts and assign roles (ADMIN/STAFF).

steps.description: Log in as administrator
Add new employee with valid details and assign STAFF role
Assert new employee is added and visible in list
Edit an employee's role to ADMIN
Assert role update is saved
Delete an employee
Assert employee is removed from the list

title: Restrict employee management module access to admin only
description: Verify that non-admin users cannot access the employee management module and receive access denied error.

steps.description: Log in as a staff user
Attempt to navigate to employee management section
Assert access is denied or redirected with appropriate message

title: Commission rule management access and CRUD
description: Verify that admin can create, edit, delete commission rules, setting percentages or fixed amounts by card type and transaction type.

steps.description: Log in as administrator
Create a commission rule for a specific card type and transaction type
Assert new rule is listed and saved
Edit commission rate or fixed amount on an existing rule
Assert changes are saved and reflected
Delete a commission rule
Assert rule is removed from the list

title: Financial statistics monthly summary and Excel export
description: Verify that monthly card opening statistics, transaction details, and commissions can be viewed and exported to Excel with accurate data.

steps.description: Navigate to financial statistics module
Select a specific month and view card opening summary and transaction details
Assert statistics reflect accurate data from database
Export statistics report to Excel
Assert Excel file downloads successfully and data is correctly formatted

title: Member overdue and expiration status auto update by scheduled task
description: Verify that the scheduled tasks update member expired statuses accurately after their card expiry dates are passed.

steps.description: Set a member's card expiry to a past date
Trigger or wait for scheduled task execution
Assert that member status is updated to expired

title: Session expiration and cleanup by scheduled task
description: Verify that expired user sessions are cleaned up automatically by scheduled background task.

steps.description: Create user session and manually expire it
Trigger or wait for scheduled session cleanup task
Assert expired session is removed from database

title: Validate unified error response format for failed API calls
description: Verify that all API failures return responses in the standard error format defined by the global exception handler.

steps.description: Send API request with invalid data causing validation error
Assert response follows the unified error JSON structure with meaningful message
Send API request to protected API with invalid or expired token
Assert response contains standardized unauthorized error format

title: Unsuccessful member renewal with invalid dates or card types
description: Verify that renewal fails with proper error messages when invalid card types or dates are provided.

steps.description: Attempt to renew a member using a disabled card type
Assert renewal is rejected with descriptive error
Attempt to submit renewal with past renewal date or invalid format
Assert renewal is rejected due to invalid date validation

title: Verify sign-in reminders for members overdue 7 days without check-in
description: Verify that members who have not checked in for over 7 days receive reminder notifications.

steps.description: Identify members without check-in records for over 7 days
Trigger the reminder notification process
Assert that reminder notifications are correctly generated or sent
